_note: Questions for the Values Compass. Dimensions match causes.json; statements match frameworks.json.

dimensions.prompt: How much uncertainty can you live with?
Where on the chain should you act?

statements.text: The best gift reduces the most suffering, wherever it is.
Some things are owed to every person, and giving should secure them.
Giving should fix what is unfair, not just soften it.
I owe the most to the people and places close to me.
My faith or tradition tells me how and what to give.
The people of the future count as much as people today.
Animals and the living world matter in their own right.
The point is to help people become who they could be.
